newsitem.title: UK: Ldn silver fixed higher, gold stays put.
newsitem.headline: Ldn silver fixed higher, gold stays put.

text.p: SILVER - Fixed higher at 467.50 cents from 466.25. Spot prices three cents lower at 467.00/468.00. Awaits New York for movement.
GOLD - Stays put at $339.60/$339.90 for most of morning trade as Europe shut for May Day holidays. Expected to jolt once New York opens. But outlook remains negative.
PLATINUM - Up 40 cents at $372.00/$373.00. Forward market eases.
PALLADIUM - Down $1.00 at $155.25/$156.25 in quiet business.
